text: Hello and welcome to Real Easy English.
zh: 大家好,欢迎收听《Real Easy English》。
zh_hant: 大家好,歡迎收聽《Real Easy English》。

text: In this podcast,
we have real conversations in easy English to help you learn.
zh: 我们用简单的英语进行真实对话,帮助大家学习。
zh_hant: 我們用簡單的英語進行真實對話,幫助大家學習。

text: I'm Neil.
And I'm Georgie.
Remember, you can watch a video version of this podcast
zh: 记得你可以观看这档播客的视频版,
zh_hant: 記得你可以觀看這檔播客的影片版,

text: on our website, bbclearningenglish.com.
zh: 就在我们的网站 bbclearningenglish.com 上。
zh_hant: 就在我們的網站 bbclearningenglish.com 上。

text: How are you today, Georgie?
I'm very well, thank you, today, Neil.
How are you?
I'm OK.
I've got one or two little worries .
Have you?
Well, that's interesting because we are talking about worries today
zh: 这可有意思了,因为我们今天这期播客
zh_hant: 這可有意思了,因為我們今天這期播客

text: in this podcast.
zh: 正好要聊烦恼这个话题。
zh_hant: 正好要聊煩惱這個話題。

text: Let's do it.
So, Neil,
you said you've got a couple of little worries .
zh: 你说你有一两件小烦心事,
zh_hant: 你說你有一兩件小煩心事,

text: Do you want to share them?
Yeah.
I think, I think when you have kids,
you're kind of slightly worried all the time.
And yesterday, my son got hurt playing cricket.
zh: 昨天我儿子打板球的时候受伤了。
zh_hant: 昨天我兒子打板球的時候受傷了。

text: And so this morning,
I just wanted to make sure
he was feeling OK before he went to school.
zh: 他去上学之前感觉还好不好。
zh_hant: 他去上學之前感覺還好不好。

text: And how was he this morning?
He seemed OK.
Yeah, he seemed a bit bruised.
Oh, no.
An injury to the knee or something?
zh: 是膝盖受伤还是什么的?
zh_hant: 是膝蓋受傷還是什麼的?

text: Shoulder.
Ouch.
And arm.
Gosh.
Yeah.
And do you...
Are you someone that worries a lot?
zh: 你是那种很容易担心的人吗?
zh_hant: 你是那種很容易擔心的人嗎?

text: No, not really.
Sometimes, but I think
there's lots of stuff that you can worry about.
zh: 值得担心的事情太多了。
zh_hant: 值得擔心的事情太多了。

text: And if you, if
you worry about all of it,
can really affect you badly.
zh: 真的会对你造成很大的负面影响。
zh_hant: 真的會對你造成很大的負面影響。

text: So I try, I know it's difficult sometimes,
zh: 所以我会尽量,虽然有时候挺难的,
zh_hant: 所以我會盡量,雖然有時候挺難的,

text: not to worry too much about things that aren't so important.
zh: 不去为那些不太重要的事情过度担心。
zh_hant: 不去為那些不太重要的事情過度擔心。

text: My thing is that worrying about a problem
zh: 我的想法是,担心一个问题
zh_hant: 我的想法是,擔心一個問題

text: or a thing
doesn't actually help.
So I'm in general,
I'm a person that doesn't worry too much.
zh: 我是那种不太爱担心的人。
zh_hant: 我是那種不太愛擔心的人。

text: I kind of just think whatever happens, happens.
zh: 我大概就是顺其自然的态度。
zh_hant: 我大概就是順其自然的態度。

text: So I'm generally quite chilled
zh: 所以我一般都挺淡定的,
zh_hant: 所以我一般都挺淡定的,

text: and relaxed.
That's true.
That's a very healthy attitude probably.
zh: 这大概是一种很健康的心态。
zh_hant: 這大概是一種很健康的心態。

text: So I don't tend to worry a lot.
zh: 所以我一般不太会担心。
zh_hant: 所以我一般不太會擔心。

text: But you, you worry a little bit because you have kids.
zh: 不过你呢,因为有孩子,会稍微担心一些。
zh_hant: 不過你呢,因為有孩子,會稍微擔心一些。

text: What kinds of things do you do to make yourself feel more relaxed?
zh: 那你都做些什么来让自己放松一点?
zh_hant: 那你都做些什麼來讓自己放鬆一點?

text: Well, I think, like you said,
zh: 嗯,我觉得,就像你说的那样,
zh_hant: 嗯,我覺得,就像你說的那樣,

text: one useful thing to do could be to try
to be rational.
So to think that what you're worried
about probably isn't that important
zh: 的事情可能并没有那么重要,
zh_hant: 的事情可能並沒有那麼重要,

text: or, or likely to happen.
zh: 或者根本不太可能发生。
zh_hant: 或者根本不太可能發生。

text: But, yeah.
So you're quite chilled , as you said.
zh: 所以你挺淡定的,就像你说的那样。
zh_hant: 所以你挺淡定的,就像你說的那樣。

text: That must be nice for your friends.
zh: 你的朋友们一定觉得跟你相处很舒服。
zh_hant: 你的朋友們一定覺得跟你相處很舒服。

text: Yes.
And if you have, like you said,
a friend who's, who worries about everything, how do you help them?
zh: 有个朋友什么事都担心,你会怎么帮他?
zh_hant: 有個朋友什麼事都擔心,你會怎麼幫他?

text: Finding maybe a distraction.
zh: 可以试着找点事分散注意力。
zh_hant: 可以試著找點事分散注意力。

text: Like something that makes you feel good.
zh: 做一些能让自己感觉良好的事情。
zh_hant: 做一些能讓自己感覺良好的事情。

text: Like a TV programme that you love.
zh: 比如看一部你很喜欢的电视节目。
zh_hant: 比如看一部你很喜歡的電視節目。

text: Or seeing friends, that love you,
zh: 或者去见那些爱你的朋友,
zh_hant: 或者去見那些愛你的朋友,

text: that can make you feel more relaxed.
zh: 这样也能让你感觉更放松。
zh_hant: 這樣也能讓你感覺更放鬆。

text: Mindfulness techniques as well.
Maybe jigsaws.
I've talked about puzzles in the past.
zh: 我以前就聊过拼图这个话题。
zh_hant: 我以前就聊過拼圖這個話題。

text: Do you have any other tips?
No. These are all very good ideas.
zh: 没有了,这些主意都很不错。
zh_hant: 沒有了,這些主意都很不錯。

text: Thank you.
Yeah.
I think it can be useful to have something that distracts you.
zh: 我觉得有件事能分散注意力挺有用的。
zh_hant: 我覺得有件事能分散注意力挺有用的。

text: Like maybe drawing,
listening
to music, playing an instrument can help.
Something that just kind of takes that time away.
zh: 就是找点事情,把那段时间占用掉。
zh_hant: 就是找點事情,把那段時間佔用掉。

text: It takes your mind off the the stress.
zh: 这样能让你暂时不去想那些压力。
zh_hant: 這樣能讓你暫時不去想那些壓力。

text: Yeah. OK.
Let's recap the vocabulary we heard during the conversation,
zh: 我们来回顾一下这次对话中出现的词汇,
zh_hant: 我們來回顧一下這次對話中出現的詞彙,

text: starting with worry .
A worry is a problem that makes you feel upset or scared,
zh: worry 指的是让你感到不安或害怕的问题,
zh_hant: worry 指的是讓你感到不安或害怕的問題,

text: and worry is also a verb.
So for example, I worry about my kids.
zh: 比如说,I worry about my kids(我担心我的孩子)。
zh_hant: 比如說,I worry about my kids(我擔心我的孩子)。

text: Yes, and we also use the adjective worried
zh: 没错,我们还用形容词 worried,
zh_hant: 沒錯,我們還用形容詞 worried,

text: to describe that feeling of being scared or upset about something.
zh: 来形容那种因为某事而感到害怕或不安的心情。
zh_hant: 來形容那種因為某事而感到害怕或不安的心情。

text: For example, I'm worried about climate change.
zh: 比如说,I'm worried about climate change(我很担心气候变化)。
zh_hant: 比如說,I'm worried about climate change(我很擔心氣候變化)。

text: And we heard the expression take your mind off something,
zh: 我们还听到了短语 take your mind off something,
zh_hant: 我們還聽到了短語 take your mind off something,

text: which means to do something to stop you worrying .
zh: 意思是做点什么事让自己不再担心。
zh_hant: 意思是做點什麼事讓自己不再擔心。

text: For example, I play my guitar
to take my mind off my worries .
zh: to take my mind off my worries(我弹吉他来让自己不再为烦恼分心)。
zh_hant: to take my mind off my worries(我彈吉他來讓自己不再為煩惱分心)。

text: We also heard chilled , which is another word for relaxed
zh: 我们还听到了 chilled,这是 relaxed(放松)
zh_hant: 我們還聽到了 chilled,這是 relaxed(放鬆)

text: or calm.
zh: 或者 calm(冷静)的另一种说法,
zh_hant: 或者 calm(冷靜)的另一種說法,

text: And it's quite an informal word.
zh: 这是一个比较口语化的词。
zh_hant: 這是一個比較口語化的詞。

text: Next time
we'll be talking
about our brains.
See you then.
Goodbye.
